record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the depreciation of the domestic currency:
      (i) A depreciation of the domestic currency generally makes exports more competitive.
     (ii) A depreciation of the domestic currency makes imports cheaper.
    Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
